title: Morning ops huddle briefing + action docket
content:
Purpose: ultra-brief alignment to unblock top risks and surface decisions for leadership team. Use this as my talking crib — keep it <3 minutes.

Attendees: CEO, COO, Head of Infra, Head of Product, Head of Eng (rotating), Incident Commander (when present).

Format: 1) signals (30s) 2) top 3 blockers (90s) 3) asks/decisions (60s) 4) quick wins & parking lot (30s)

SIGNALS (one-line each):
- Infra: cluster utilization amber — short GPU shortage in us-west due to batch jobs, autoscale pending tweak.
- Product: feature-flag rollout for caching experiment largely green but 5% error spike in Canada.
- SRE: SLO error budget at 0.7 days remaining for /v1/chat route (watching).

TOP 3 BLOCKERS (why it matters / immediate owner / expected ETA):
1) Dedicated capacity fails over to fallback model unexpectedly (affects high-value customers). Owner: Ethan Park. ETA: 6h mitigation, 48h root cause. Short-term: manual routing pin for customers in affected pool.
2) Billing ingestion lag — analytics delayed by ~3 hours impacting billing dashboard and quota alerts. Owner: Lina Zhou. ETA: 24h. Ask: temporary alert suppression + manual run of ingestion backfill.
3) Low recall regression on internal eval set after quantization experiment on core-rewrite model. Owner: Head of Applied ML. ETA: 72h. Ask: rollback or canary to previous quantization profile.

ASKS / DECISIONS NEEDED (explicit):
- Approve manual routing pin for 3 enterprise customers to avoid fallback (CEO sign-off via Slack thread). Owner: Priya Nair. Ideal by EOD.
- Greenlight immediate backfill run for billing ingestion (ops budget ok). Owner: COO. Approve now.
- Decision on rollback vs canary for quantization regression (product + applied-ml). Recommend canary to 10% traffic. Owner: Head of Product. Decision by next sync.

QUICK WINS / MITIGATIONS:
- Turn off noncritical batch jobs in us-west for 2h (SRE).
- Add short-term rate-limiter bump for internal test tenants to avoid spurious errors.

PARKING LOT (items to track outside daily huddle):
- Long-term capacity plan for Dedicated to reduce single-region pressure (owner: Head of Infra).
- Billing pipeline refactor proposal (owner: Lina).
- Quantization testing harness improvements (owner: Applied ML).

FOLLOW-UPS / ACTION DOCKET (owner / due / status):
- Priya: post Slack thread with routing pin ask + link to customer impact doc / due 2026-03-10 EOD / status: pending.
- Ethan: implement manual routing pin + notify customers / due 2026-03-11 14:00 / status: in_progress.
- Lina: run ingestion backfill + quick postmortem / due 2026-03-11 18:00 / status: pending.
- Head of Applied ML: prepare canary rollout plan + rollback gates / due 2026-03-12 / status: pending.

NOTES TO SELF (prep & reminders):
- Keep comments high-level in huddle; push technical deep dives to follow-up ticket ENG-4321.
- Bring up the SLO fragility to avoid surprise escalations; ask SRE for a proposed guardrail.
- After huddle: update scoreboard doc and tag follow-ups in 1:1 with each owner.

Quick checklist before huddle:
- Open Confluence playbook and customer impact doc.
- DM CEO with routing pin summary.
- Confirm Ethan/Lina online.

End of crib — use as script but adapt to live updates.
